findings: Fit with ADR 0001 (composable stations): the contract lives in the spine (anvil/runner.py, gates.py, approver.py, model.py) and no file under pipelines/ is touched. It stays channel-agnostic because it keys on a writes_artifacts executor attribute and not on a model brand.

Layering is clean. Deterministic checks (validate_builder_report, review_artifact_state) sit in gates.py. Aggregation honesty sits in approver.py, which keeps the old logic as _counted_explained, so behavior is unchanged when every expected reviewer is counted. The runner only orchestrates.
required_literals is an optional WorkOrder field validated in model.py and serialized only when set, so existing work orders round-trip unchanged.

The approver now returns human_required for an uncounted expected reviewer, and the runner extends the needs_human_explained verdict set to match. decision.approver gains reviews_uncounted, which is additive.

Minor: transcript_path is duplicated in tools/claude_station.py and tools/codex_station.py. The two wrappers already duplicate most of their logic, so this is consistent with the existing structure, but it is a candidate for a shared helper later.

Minor: the wrappers treat any existing non-empty <station>.output.md as a station-written artifact. The runner removes a stale builder.output.md before each attempt but not a stale reviewer output file, so a reviewer loopback could in theory reuse one. The review.json is still deleted and required, so the verdict path is not affected.
No em dash or en dash characters were found in anvil/ or tools/ or in the new test files. I did not wait for the full test suite to finish, so I have not confirmed S5 (no regressions) myself.
